description: Use to add documents to one of the user's projects: `documents` [{corpus, key, title?}] and/or `uploads` (dataset ids of their own files, from geothought_uploads or upload_data). Only the user's own files can be added; GeoThought reads at most 50 of one user's own files (2,000 pages) across their projects. Returns how many were added and the project's document count.
name: geothought_add_documents
title: Add documents to a project
